rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, thing, or system that is not dependable.

example.english: This old computer keeps crashing; it is really unreliable.
example.traditional: 呢部舊電腦成日死機，真係唔可靠。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 seng4 jat6 sei2 gei1 zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 kaau3

rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong expression especially for plans, arrangements, or situations that may go wrong.

example.english: Relying on the weather to decide whether to travel is really unreliable.
example.traditional: 靠天氣決定去唔去旅行，呢個安排真係唔穩陣。
example.jyutping: kaau3 tin1 hei3 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 zan1 hai6 m4 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that a person or source cannot be trusted or relied on.

example.english: This online news source is unreliable.
example.traditional: 呢個網上消息來源唔信得過。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 soeng6 siu1 sik1 loi4 jyun4 m4 seon3 dak1 gwo3
